bridge/parseInstallScript/conditionals.divergenceNote: The recorded Rust result carries forward slashes where the oracle kept the file's decoded backslashes: the cargo golden recorder (tests/golden.rs tokenise) rewrites every backslash in every string to '/' so path-shaped values compare across hosts. The Rust parser itself decodes the VDF escapes to the same backslash string (parseKv1 parity), so this is a recording artefact, not a behaviour difference; downstream consumers split Process paths on both separators.
